name: Classic Blue Denim Jacket
description: A timeless cropped denim jacket with button front closure, chest pockets, and adjustable cuffs. Made from 100% cotton denim with a comfortable relaxed fit. Perfect for casual outings and everyday wear.

name: Maroon Embroidered Jacket
description: A traditional embroidered jacket with intricate mirror work and floral patterns. Features a Nehru collar and full sleeve design. Perfect for festive occasions and cultural events.

name: Grey Quilted Winter Jacket
description: A warm quilted jacket with down-like filling for cold weather. Features a full zip front, side pockets, and a detachable hood. Lightweight yet very warm.

name: Floral Midi Dress
description: A beautiful floral print midi dress with elegant puff sleeves and a cinched waist. Made from lightweight georgette fabric. Perfect for brunches, parties and casual outings.

name: Black Bodycon Dress
description: A sleek and elegant black bodycon dress with a V-neckline and short sleeves. Stretchy fabric provides a comfortable fit. Great for evening outings and formal events.

name: Pink Wrap Dress
description: A flattering wrap dress in soft pink with adjustable waist ties. Features a V-neckline and flutter sleeves. Versatile for both casual and semi-formal occasions.

name: White Classic Sneakers
description: Classic white leather sneakers with a cushioned sole and breathable interior. Features a lace-up closure and rubber outsole for grip. Versatile for everyday casual wear.

name: Red Mesh Running Shoes
description: Lightweight red mesh running shoes with responsive cushioning and breathable upper. Features a rubber outsole for traction and a padded collar for comfort during long runs.

name: Brown Leather Ankle Boots
description: Stylish brown leather ankle boots with a block heel and side zip for easy wear. Features a cushioned insole and durable rubber outsole. Great for both work and weekends.

name: Blue Canvas Sneakers
description: Casual blue canvas sneakers with a flat rubber sole and lace-up closure. Lightweight and comfortable for everyday wear. Available in multiple colors.

name: Navy Blue Polo T-Shirt
description: A classic polo t-shirt in navy blue with ribbed collar and cuffs. Made from breathable cotton fabric with a regular fit. Perfect for casual and smart-casual occasions.

name: White Graphic Tee
description: An oversized white graphic tee with a vintage band print. Made from 100% combed cotton for a super soft feel. Great for layering or wearing alone.

name: Striped Oversized Hoodie
description: A comfortable pullover hoodie with bold horizontal stripes and a kangaroo pocket. Soft fleece lining for warmth. Relaxed fit for casual wear.

name: Black Slim Formal Trousers
description: Slim fit black formal trousers with a straight leg cut and mid-rise waist. Features side pockets and a hook and bar closure. Ideal for office and formal occasions.

name: Light Blue Flared Jeans
description: High-waist flared jeans in a light wash denim. Features a 5-pocket design and a button fly closure. Retro style with a modern comfortable fit.

name: Olive Green Cargo Pants
description: Relaxed fit cargo pants with multiple utility pockets and an adjustable drawstring waist. Made from durable cotton twill fabric. Great for outdoor activities and casual wear.

name: Black Sports Leggings
description: High-waist compression leggings with moisture-wicking fabric and a 4-way stretch. Features a hidden waistband pocket. Perfect for yoga, gym workouts, and running.

name: White Cotton Straight Kurta
description: A soft cotton straight-cut kurta with a delicate embroidered collar and full sleeves. Features side slits for ease of movement. Perfect for festive and casual wear.

name: Yellow Block Print Kurti
description: A Rajasthani block print short kurti with three-quarter sleeves and a round neckline. Made from soft cotton fabric. Pairs well with jeans, leggings or palazzos.

name: Pink Georgette Printed Saree
description: A vibrant pink printed georgette saree with a contrast blouse piece. Features an elegant floral print and a smooth flowing drape. Perfect for weddings and celebrations.

name: Brown Leather Structured Handbag
description: A structured brown leather handbag with gold hardware and multiple compartments including a zip pocket and card slots. Suitable for work and daily use.

name: Multicolor Silk Scarf
description: A luxurious silk scarf with an abstract print in multiple colors. Can be worn as a neck scarf, headband, wrist wrap, or bag accessory. Adds elegance to any outfit.

name: Charcoal Grey Formal Blazer
description: A single-breasted formal blazer in charcoal grey with notched lapels and a two-button closure. Features a structured shoulder and two front flap pockets. Pairs with formal trousers.

name: Beige Cotton Casual Shorts
description: Relaxed fit cotton shorts with a drawstring waist and two side pockets. Made from breathable cotton fabric. Ideal for home, beach, and casual outings.

name: Blue Athletic Track Pants
description: Comfortable athletic track pants with a drawstring waist and side zip pockets. Made from quick-dry fabric. Perfect for gym, jogging, and outdoor sports.

name: Red Crop Top
description: A stylish red crop top with a square neckline and short puff sleeves. Made from stretchy cotton blend fabric. Great for casual outings paired with jeans or skirts.

name: Black Leather Belt
description: A classic black leather belt with a silver buckle. Suitable for both formal and casual wear. Available in multiple sizes.

name: White Linen Shirt
description: A breezy white linen shirt with a relaxed fit and button-down collar. Features a chest pocket and roll-up sleeve tabs. Perfect for summer and beach vacations.

name: Green Floral Maxi Skirt
description: A flowy green floral maxi skirt with an elastic waist and a ruffled hem. Made from lightweight chiffon. Great for beach outings and summer events.

name: Navy Blue Denim Shirt
description: A casual navy blue denim shirt with a button-down collar and two chest pockets. Can be worn as a top or as a light jacket over a tee. Versatile and durable.
